title: 正阶单行 Schur 函数与斜 Schur 函数的交错 Pieri 展开
source_title: A Pieri rule for skew shapes
difficulty_reason: The proof must construct coordinated inward and outward skew-tableau bumping paths whose relative positions permit opposite-parity inverse moves. The author proves the resulting map is a content-preserving involution, then identifies and reconstructs its fixed points through a monotone sequence of reverse insertions. The appendix gives an alternative using a proved adjoint multiplication identity beyond ordinary Pieri; it is another proof of this same target.

proof_spans.label: Section 4 from p5 offset 1529 to p8 offset 3163 (exclusive). Row and reverse-row insertion, Defs 4.3/4.5, Lemmas 4.7/4.8 with proofs and needed diagrams. Stops before proof of ordinary Pieri Theorem 3.1.

Section 5 from p9 offset 137 to p14 offset 1230 (exclusive). D/U slide definitions and well-definedness, Theorem 5.8 with proof, and complete Proof of Theorem 3.2 at p14 offset 72 ending in the inverse fixed-point bijection.
